BrochureContent.Content:
Buckley Real Estate are proud to present Apartment 1,  Rathlin Hall to the Dublin sales market.   Nestled within a peaceful, well-kept development, this vibrant complex offers everything at your doorstep. From top-tier healthcare at nearby Connolly Hospital to a wide range of excellent schools—including St. Patrick’s, Educate Together, and TU Dublin— Waterville is ideal for families, students, and  alike. The area is beautifully landscaped and offers a strong sense of safety and neighbourly charm, all just minutes from Blanchardstown Village. One designated parking space and plenty of guest spaces will assure that there is always ample parking for family / friends alike.  

Waterville Park situated directly across the road is a beautiful green escape, a place where nature and community meet in a calm, welcoming setting. At the heart of the park lies a serene lake, its surface often dotted with graceful swans and cheerful ducks gliding by. The water creates a peaceful backdrop for anyone out for a stroll, a moment of reflection, or simply enjoying the scenery. Winding walkways weave through the park, perfect for leisurely walks, jogging, or taking in the fresh air. Along the paths, plenty of seating and benches offer quiet spots to rest, read, or watch the world go by. Families are well-catered for, with bright, well-kept playgrounds that bring children together in laughter and play. For those looking to stay active, there’s even an adult and child exercise area, creating a fun way to work out while spending time together outdoors. Overall, Waterville Park is a vibrant, relaxing space—ideal for nature lovers, families, and anyone who wants to enjoy the simple beauty of an inviting green area.
The property is also located in easy access to the M50 (10 mins to airport) and N3, frequent Dublin Bus routes such as the 220, N4, and 38, and nearby Coolmine and Castleknock train stations for seamless city commutes. Also located nearby are plenty of recreational activities, such as The Millennium Park’s skatepark, football pitches, and playgrounds. You’re also within easy reach of the Royal Canal’s scenic walkways, the state-of-the-art National Aquatic Centre, and Coolmine’s swimming facilities. For shopping, dining and entertainment,  the Blanchardstown Centre is just a short walk or drive away, this retail haven features over 180 stores, restaurants, a cinema, and the popular Draíocht Arts Centre.

This property will suit a range of buyers such as first time buyers, those looking to down size and investors. Early viewing is highly advised.

This property is a stunning ground floor apartment located in the sought after area of Blanchardstown, Dublin 15. The apartment is a generous two double bedroom, two bath property which has recently been upgraded and interior designed to a very high standard. The property opens into a large entrance hallway with the spacious living and dining area immediately upon entrance. Large ceiling to floor windows flood this room with natural light keeping it airy and bright, with French doors leading into a spacious sheltered south west facing patio terrace area. Adjoined to this room is the fully fitted kitchen with all the mod cons that you could need. The living / dining / kitchen area has newly fitted wooden flooring throughout. Returning to the hallway, the large family bathroom is immediately on the right. It is fully fitted with shower and bath facilities and is beautifully finished. To the rear of the hallway you can find both large double bedrooms. Both are stylishly equipped with fitted wardrobes. The master is complimented by a stylish en suite bathroom. Windows in both of these rooms allow natural light to flood into the property allowing for sun filled accommodation. The property is finished with a small balcony.

Recently refurbished

Short walk to Blanchardstown Village

Well serviced public transport area along with easy access to a number of major motorways
